description: Where the graded-Pokémon market stands in its cycle, per language track (all / en / ja): a one-line phase read backed by a fixed-basket same-card index (never vibes), peak/drawdown numbers, weekly verified-sale counts, and an upcoming release/event calendar. Not investment advice. Reads POKEKA market data only; server-side request logging is disclosed in the privacy policy; does not modify user data.
name: get_market_brief

change_30d_band.description: Banded version of change_30d_pct (last 7 days vs the same window one month earlier, not a 30-day change).

change_30d_pct.description: Percent change of the median sale price over the last 7 days versus the 7-day window one month earlier. Despite the key name, this is not a 30-day change; quote it as 'this week vs a month ago'.

title: Market brief
